mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one who oversees the activities at the gate lodge."
The gateman is the one who oversees the activities at the gate lodge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ultimate sanction, the most symbolic reminder of the state's power to punish its citizens."
Capital punishment is the ultimate sanction, the most symbolic reminder of the state's power to punish its citizens.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major problems facing the Nigerian prison service."
Congestion is one of the major problems facing the Nigerian prison service.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major tools for effective reformation and rehabilitation."
One-third remission is one of the major tools for effective reformation and rehabilitation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the major causes of the problems in the prison system."
Prison congestion is one of the major causes of the problems in the prison system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sine qua non in the formation of the officers' corps of the Nigeria Prisons Service, and in the inducement of esprit de corps."
Training is a sine qua non in the formation of the officers' corps of the Nigeria Prisons Service, and in the inducement of esprit de corps.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of punishing offenders was not new to many pre-colonial communities in Africa."
Imprisonment as a means of punishing offenders was not new to many pre-colonial communities in Africa.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for escapes in our prisons."
Several reasons are responsible for escapes in our prisons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very serious matter as far as the prison is concerned."
Escape is a very serious matter as far as the prison is concerned.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means to act as judge to hear evidence, examine witness, access a case and arrive at findings."
Adjudication generally means to act as judge to hear evidence, examine witness, access a case and arrive at findings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the small window made on the outer gate through which the gate keeper sees the person (visitor) knocking at the gate."
Gate grill is the small window made on the outer gate through which the gate keeper sees the person (visitor) knocking at the gate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a piece of authority paper normally issued by the court of law to the prisons authorities."
A warrant is a piece of authority paper normally issued by the court of law to the prisons authorities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an authority issued in writing by a court to the person making the arrest."
A warrant of arrest is an authority issued in writing by a court to the person making the arrest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those officers who are not specialized in any kind of trade."
General duty officers (warders) are those officers who are not specialized in any kind of trade.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most visible governmental agents through whom citizens often assess the character of a government and political system."
Police are the most visible governmental agents through whom citizens often assess the character of a government and political system.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unauthorized or 'unpermitted' transmission of either a message or item into or out of the prison; that is, when such message or item is sanctioned by the prison authority."

Trafficking in very simple terms is the unauthorized or 'unpermitted' transmission of either a message or item into or out of the prison; that is, when such message or item is sanctioned by the prison authority.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the subordinate head of the junior staff."
The chief warder is the subordinate head of the junior staff.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a combination word comprising the two elements homo (from Greek for same) and sexuality (noun) meaning sexual appeal, potency or orientation."
Homosexuality is a combination word comprising the two elements homo (from Greek for same) and sexuality (noun) meaning sexual appeal, potency or orientation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only authority the prison superintendent has for holding a prisoner in the prison."
A commitment warrant is the only authority the prison superintendent has for holding a prisoner in the prison.

Treatment of prisoners
Treatment of prisoners is a very important factor that should be examined as a prelude or complement to the concepts of the rehabilitation and reformation of prison inmates.
______ is regarded as the responsibility of the judge, and perhaps nowhere else in legal proceedings is the power of the judge more evident.
Sentencing
Sentencing is regarded as the responsibility of the judge, and perhaps nowhere else in legal proceedings is the power of the judge more evident.

trial
A trial is defined as an adversary proceeding with the rules of evidence resembling rule of a game, and the judge as an impartial umpire.
______ is the centre of attraction in the criminal court.
accused
The accused is the centre of attraction in the criminal court.
______ is a sensitive stakeholder in the criminal justice system.
Nigerian prisons service
The Nigerian prisons service is a sensitive stakeholder in the criminal justice system.
______ is the overall boss of the prison.
Superintendent In-charge
The Superintendent In-charge is the overall boss of the prison.
______ is an exclusive prerogative of the Judges and Magistrates.
Adjournment
Adjournment is an exclusive prerogative of the Judges and Magistrates.
______ is one of the three organs of government made up of the representatives of the people.
legislature
The legislature is one of the three organs of government made up of the representatives of the people.
______ are the legislative houses in the various states.
States Houses of Assembly
States Houses of Assembly are the legislative houses in the various states.
______ refers to a compilation of the names of convicted prisoners due for discharge six weeks before the first day of the month to which it relates.
Discharge list
Discharge list refers to a compilation of the names of convicted prisoners due for discharge six weeks before the first day of the month to which it relates.
______ is a chart containing relevant information about an escape.
Escape chart
Escape chart is a chart containing relevant information about an escape.
______ is the eye of the prison through which the outer world sees it.
gate
The gate is the eye of the prison through which the outer world sees it.

______ is a very important function in prison administration.
Classification
Classification is a very important function in prison administration.
______ is a problem that will never allow proper and effective correction of prison inmates.
Congestion in the prison
Congestion in the prison is a problem that will never allow proper and effective correction of prison inmates.
______ is the stenographer who takes down transcript motions and comments of witnesses and participants in a trial.
court reporter
The court reporter is the stenographer who takes down transcript motions and comments of witnesses and participants in a trial.
______ means making the offender better by trying to change his delinquent behaviours.
Reformation
Reformation means making the offender better by trying to change his delinquent behaviours.
______ is the concluding part of admission formalities of prisoners into the prison.
Admission or reception board
Admission or reception board is the concluding part of admission formalities of prisoners into the prison.
______ is a situation where the State Governor decides to reduce a life imprisonment to a term of imprisonment.
Amnesty
Amnesty is a situation where the State Governor decides to reduce a life imprisonment to a term of imprisonment.
